title: BOS-984 trash restore — the streaming resurrect renders live setup progress instead of a silent spinner

scenes.title: open Trash, which lists the archived sessions

steps.caption: Open Settings from the home board
Trash list loaded (demo world seeds five archived sessions)

expect.label: the first archived session, the one [r]estore will act on

steps.caption: An archived session is selected and restorable

scenes.title: restoring shows the live setup-script line — the BOS-984 fix

steps.caption: Press [r] to restore the selected archived session
The first progress frame off the resurrect stream reaches the TUI

expect.label: the restore is still in flight (spinner label, ellipsis character per BOS-1087)
THE FIX: a live progress line from the streaming resurrect, appended to the spinner label

steps.caption: Before BOS-984 this was a bare restore spinner and nothing else, right up until the client deadline turned a healthy restore into deadline_exceeded. (The label is quoted unspelled on purpose: at that time it still elided with three full stops, so naming a spelling here would date the sentence wrongly.)

scenes.title: progress advances to the setup script itself

steps.caption: The second progress frame — the repo's setup script, the leg that used to blow the deadline

expect.label: setup-script output streaming live into the restore label

steps.caption: Setup-script output streaming live into the restore label. Asserted here rather than on the final phase line, whose visible window is ~0ms because the terminal frame follows it immediately.

scenes.title: the restore settles and the app opens the restored session

steps.caption: Terminal SessionResurrected frame received — App.updateTrash routes into the chat picker for the restored session (app_delegate.go), so the spinner is gone rather than hanging
Hold the settled screen so the capture records the destination rather than ending mid-restore

expect.label: the chat picker's action bar — reachable only once the restore SETTLED, so this is the proof the stream terminated cleanly
the restored session is the one now open

steps.caption: The stream ended on its terminal frame and the session is live. Before BOS-984 this point was never reached: the unary call died on the client deadline while the daemon was still running the setup script.
